audit_notes: Raw OCR is mostly fragments; a few labels survive (INBIFO KOELN, ETABLISSEMENT ART-61) but the amounts and total are wrong. Otsu recovers the client, company, line-item descriptions and most amounts including the 1150.00 total, though some digits are wrong and speckle noise adds junk lines. Otsu preferred.

Both outputs keep the Borriston header, date, addressee, invoice number 1582-1, the purchase order line and the $1,500.00 charge, but both miss the BLI reference number 231582 and the phone number is imperfect in each. Raw gets more of the printed words right (Borriston, AMOUNT, B-30, Dynamac International). Otsu has Bornston, AMDUNT, 8-30 and Intemational, but partly picks up the handwritten Dept./Acct. annotation that raw misses. Raw preferred.

Both outputs keep the body paragraph, salutation, sign-off, WSK:elh/Enc. and the slogan, and both misread the year (1954 read as 195k / 195)). Raw loses the addressee name (Mr. W. T. Hoyt) and almost all of the letterhead. Otsu recovers the addressee, Quality Products Since 1875, Winston-Salem and many of the director names, and partly reads the Reynolds logo, though reading order is scrambled and several names are garbled. Neither reads the handwritten notes (Mr. L. Catlett, File, Cig Paper). Otsu preferred.

Clean typed letter; both outputs capture the date, addressee, headings and nearly all of the body and bullet points. Raw errors are small (hes, thd, 10 pursue, ire for hire, ofthe). Otsu fixes those but introduces its own (scienufic controve with the end of controversies lost, cigareite, nat limited, cvaluated, wilt, conducl and a stray ies: line). Error counts are similar and the same content is preserved. No clear improvement; raw selected as the tie convention.

Telefax cover sheet. Raw garbles the printed header block (F.T.R. Research and Development, Neuchatel / Switzerland, Facsimile Transmission) and the Telefax Copy and Eingegangen stamps. Otsu recovers the F.T.R. header, Neuchatel / Switzerland, the Facsimile Transmission line and call number, and Telefax Cop. Both read the Philip Morris copies list, the call-if-not-received instruction (32.11.11 Ext. 603) and Remarks; Otsu also gets the Remarks label cleanly. Both garble the handwritten To, From, date and page count; raw keeps the recipient name (Dr. W. Resninghaus) while Otsu loses it. Borderline 1 vs 2: Otsu preferred for the recovered printed headings.

Dense progress-report form with large numeric tables. Both outputs garble the Package Plans table numbers and the Carton Plans section, so the table data is unusable in both. Raw keeps the region name (Manhattan, 02) and a garbled version of the footer note (Quarterly Merchandising Void report, Region Recap, R.W. Caldarella), but its instruction paragraphs have many errors (bo, thelr, Lorritores, goographics) and its table headers are garbled. Otsu reads the title, instruction paragraphs and the CHAIN / INDEP. header row much more cleanly and recovers month labels, but drops the region name and the footer note. Marginal Otsu preference; some uncertainty.

Typewritten fellowship application. Both outputs read the title, positions, institutions, places and publication reference well enough to follow the whole page. Otsu reads the field labels in order (Name, Present Position, Former Positions, Publication) and gets Muncie, Manhattan, Assistant and the 1954 publication year right; raw misorders the labels, loses Former, and has liuncie, Assistent, Manhatten and 195k. Years are the weak point in both because the typewriter 4 is misread: Bachelor of Science 1942 comes out as 192 (raw) or 1912 (Otsu), and Summer 1943 as 19,3 or 1913. Otsu also adds a few stray artifacts. Otsu preferred.

NIH biographical sketch form. Both outputs read the title, name, position (Associate Professor of Neurology), instructions and the long training and appointments lists well enough to follow. Otsu is cleaner on dates and titles (1984-1986, Assistant Resident, 1996- Associate Professor) while raw has errors such as 19841986, 1986-1587, 196 and Assrare. The education table (Williams College, Antwerp, Medical College of Ohio) is partly kept by raw as institution and field names without degrees or years, and missing entirely in Otsu even though the table is visible in the Otsu image. Marginal Otsu preference; some uncertainty.

Cursive handwritten note on ruled paper requesting order forms, coupons and a booklet. Raw keeps enough phrases to follow the request (Have THE Time, order forms, Coupons, booklet, order, from your Company Please? Thanks, THE seals, The Forms, Can get, Please) although words are garbled and the date is misread (441/96 for 12/1/96). Otsu keeps only scattered words (Time, Send, order, booklet, from your, seals, Forms), loses the date and the closing lines, and the thickened ruled lines produce several junk lines. Raw preferred; Otsu is borderline 0 vs 1.

Cursive handwritten letter about Doral cigarettes, signed Megan Gray, that is clearly legible to a human. Both outputs are nearly unusable: only the date (8-21-00) and one or two words survive (Coupon in raw; Thank and Roads in Otsu), and the sender name, address and the body of the message are lost in both. No clear improvement; raw selected as the tie convention.
